Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
LSJ wrote:
>
> Recently, on either the newsgroup or the mailing list (or both),
> I made a ruling that Legacy of Pander is not cumulative.
>
> I based this ruling on the Legacy of Pander's card text
> as listed on the WotC web page:
>
> If this vote is successful, put this card in play. Each non-titled
> Pander has one vote. This card may be burned by a vote called by any
> Sabbat vampire as a (D) action.
>
> This text is produces a non-cumulative effect. However, I have been
> informed by R. David Zopf that the actual card text is
>
> If this vote is successful, put this card in play. Each non-titled
> Pander has one additional vote. This card may be burned by a vote
> called by any Sabbat vampire as a +1 stealth action.
>
> This text produces a cumulative effect. So, if this latter text is
> correct (and I have no reason to doubt David - I'm just emphasizing
> that I'm not able to verify the card text myself), then Legacy of
> Pander is cumulative.
>
> Sorry for the confusion.
>
> --
> L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com)
> Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
> (*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

So which is it? The +1 or the 1 vote version that is official. Can
you get WotC to modify their web page if it is wrong?
--

Quicksilver <michae...@lmco.com> wrote:

> LSJ wrote:
> > Recently, on either the newsgroup or the mailing list (or both),
> > I made a ruling that Legacy of Pander is not cumulative.
> >

> > [The card text as given on the WotC site has a non-cumulative effect]

> > However, I have been informed by R. David Zopf that

> > [The actual card text is written so as to be cumulative].

> >
> > So, if this latter text is
> > correct (and I have no reason to doubt David - I'm just emphasizing
> > that I'm not able to verify the card text myself), then Legacy of
> > Pander is cumulative.
>

> So which is it? The +1 or the 1 vote version that is official. Can
> you get WotC to modify their web page if it is wrong?

It is whichever way the card is printed. No errata has been issued, so
card text stands. If (for JOL), you have no method of checking card
text, then go with WotC's spoiler list. Sorry, that's the best I can do.

As for changing the WotC list if it is wrong, I'll add this correction
to the list. But the list has been around for a while now, and no
corrections have made it through "the process".

Do not lose hope, however. "The process" has just managed to replaced the
archaic "Reversal of Fortunes" edition of the FAQ with the Oct. 1, 1997
version of the Rulings Summary (apparently culled from the VTES-L list,
judging by the last line of the page):

http://www.wizards.com/VTES/VTES_Rulings.txt
